name: Bluster Rift
desc: The Bluster Rift is a location in _Deepwoken_. It can be found on [Aratel Island](location:aratel_island). It is almost identical to the [Starswept Valley](location:the_starswept_valley). The rivers that flow here will pull you downstream, making it quite difficult to traverse.
additional_info:
-   The waters will push you downstream, eventually pushing you off a waterfall. Mind your step!
-   Not very worth grinding here, unless you're specifically looking for the Crimson Megalodaunt. It's better to grind at [Starswept Valley](location:the_starswept_valley) - they have the same events but better spawn rates and a more accessible location.
